flags.title: BNB Ningbo Open - Ningbo, CHN: published clock is local, not UTC
flags.detail: The WTA feed publishes 2026-10-24T17:30+08:00 with a local offset. The row keeps the published clock string and does not convert it, because the venue timezone is not stated in the feed.

flags.title: URC kick-off clocks published as IRE & UK, converted as if UTC
flags.detail: unitedrugby.com prints 'KO 19.45 IRE & UK'. The row stores that clock as the UTC start only where Ireland and the UK share UTC+0; in October both are on IST/BST (UTC+1), so every stored start is one hour earlier than the true UTC face-off. The published clock is quoted verbatim in the inputs column so a reviewer can see the difference.

flags.title: Danish fixture kick-off times come from the OLBG listing, not from an official feed
flags.detail: tophaandbold.dk's standings page does not publish the fixture list; the start clock on these rows is the OLBG listing clock. The teams, table values and lines are official; the clock is not.

flags.title: ATP start clock blank on order-of-play rows
flags.detail: The official ATP order-of-play PDF prints court order and 'not before' times but no date-qualified UTC timestamp accepted by this desk, so the start clock is blank rather than inferred.
